description: Action bar tied to the context, kept during scrolling.

howToUse: Use it to keep the context and the actions of a long page in view while scrolling: the item open, its state, Save.
Show it with `visible` once the original header leaves the screen. Fill `title`, `status` and `actions`.
alternatives: Save and cancel at the end of a form: StickyFooter.

keyboard.action: Moves through the actions of the bar.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
